scope: Single-host durable ObjectStore adapter, unbounded object artifact streaming, and authorized open-directory export
summary: Added a filesystem ObjectStore adapter with staged streaming writes, digest/size verification, atomic publication, range reads and idempotent receipts; connected it to unbounded T1/T2 object artifact upload and authorized streamed reads; added lease-fenced artifact exports with a repeatable-read snapshot, hash-indexed manifest, JSONL records and persisted completion state.
commands: corepack pnpm --filter @abh/core exec node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/artifacts.test.ts test/database.test.ts test/filesystem-object-store.test.ts test/artifact-export.test.ts
boundaries: Cross-host distributed and managed cloud ObjectStore adapters remain open
Public HTTP and typed-client large-body upload remains open
Production hosting, external cloud acceptance, and export expiry sweeping remain open
